intro: This covers markcheli.com and the apps I run under it on a server in my basement, Cookbook, Tasks, Tallied and the Homelab MCP connector among them. They are small and mostly for my own use, so this is short.

sections.heading: This site
paragraphs: There are no accounts here, no ads and no analytics.
If you send me a note with the message command, the name, email and message you type go to my phone through a notification service on the same server. Nothing puts them in a database.
Like most web servers, mine may log requests (IP address, time, the page asked for) to help with troubleshooting.

sections.heading: Signing in with Google
paragraphs: Some of my apps, the Homelab MCP connector included, let you sign in with a Google account. The connector asks Google for your email address and the basic sign-in identity only: nothing from Gmail, Drive, Contacts or anywhere else.
The email address is used for one thing, checking it against the short list of people allowed in. For the connector, that list is me.

sections.heading: What happens to it
paragraphs: Information from Google is used only to sign you in, and is kept only as long as the session needs it. It is not sold, shared or used for advertising.
Anything you add to an app yourself, like a recipe or a task, stays in that app on my server.
